slides.0.title: Level 4 final assessment
slides.0.subtitle: Timing of fortification × maturation = style
slides.1.title: Level 4 key points
slides.1.highlights.0.title: Principles
slides.1.highlights.0.content: Fortify mid-fermentation → sweet; after fermentation → dry; reductive keeps fruit, oxidative brings nuts, flor brings almond; solera wines carry no vintage; estufagem about 45–50°C for at least three months
slides.1.highlights.1.title: Sherry
slides.1.highlights.1.content: Albariza, Palomino, PX; Fino 15–15.5%, Oloroso 17%+; Manzanilla only in Sanlúcar; Amontillado flor then oxidative; VOS 20, VORS 30
slides.1.highlights.2.title: Port, Madeira and others
slides.1.highlights.2.content: Aguardente at about 77%; LBV 4–6 years, Vintage bottled after about 2, Colheita at least 7; Madeira Sercial→Verdelho→Boal→Malvasia, Frasqueira 20 years; Rutherglen’s four tiers; Marsala Vergine 5 years
slides.1.content: D5 answer formula: fortification timing (sweetness) → maturation (style) → time and classification (price).
slides.2.componentProps.slide.title: 📋 Level 4 final assessment
Fortifying after fermentation is complete usually gives what style?
Most Sherry is made this way.
What is the main role of albariza soil?
A. Absorbing winter rain and crusting to hold water in summer
It helps vines survive the hot, dry summer.
B. Amontillado-like nose with Oloroso-like body
A rare style between the two.
Why does Port need fast, intense extraction?
C. Fermentation lasts only two or three days before fortification
D. The grapes have very thin skins
With so little time, treading or autovinifiers are needed for colour and tannin.
Which of the Douro’s three subregions is hottest and driest?
C. All three are the same
Baixo Corgo is coolest and wettest.
How long must Madeira Frasqueira age in cask at minimum?
What is special about the sheds where Rutherglen Muscat ages?
B. Hot, speeding oxidation and concentration
Which Marsala colour category may include mosto cotto?
